title: ListingReport
description: Every harness listing for the global scope and the requested project.

listings.description: Rows in scope, then harness, order.

HarnessListing.description: One harness listing in one scope.

base_prompt_skills.description: Rendered base prompt skills section, including markup and file locations.

budget.description: Budget when this report computed one for the client.

full_size.description: Full preview size in `budget_unit`, or an estimate from discovered metadata for discovery rows.

context_window_tokens.description: Context window in tokens, when known.

description_char_limit.description: Effective Claude Code skillListingMaxDescChars in this scope.

description_limit_setting.description: The layer controlling the Claude Code per-skill cap, independent of its total budget.

configured_model.description: Configured model, independent of the model in the last recorded session.

context_source.description: Where the context window came from.

uses_default_context_window.description: True when no model or context size was found.

notes.description: What Skill Studio infers instead of reading.

setting.description: The setting that controls the budget.

thresholds.description:
The costs that decide which tier the listing is in, when the
harness has tiers (Codex).

entries.description: Entries in listing order; hidden entries last.

ListingEvidence.description: Evidence behind the current listing row. Session captures are reported independently.

oneOf.description: A prediction produced by a supported client renderer.

AgentIdentity.description:
Kebab-case harness identifier, for example `claude-code` or `opencode`.

Legacy spellings are normalized at input boundaries.

ProjectRef.description:
Absolute path of a tracked project directory.

Invariant: the path is canonical inside a [`crate::scope::NormalizedScope`].
Wire values are the lexical path the caller gave.

ListingSetting.description: The setting that controls the budget, and how to change it.

chezmoi_source.description:
chezmoi source file when chezmoi manages `file`: edit this one, or
chezmoi reverts the change.

snippet.description: The text to put in `file` for the requested budget.

edit_revision.description: Revision needed for an in-app edit. Absent for managed, linked and read-only settings.

ConfiguredListingModel.description: Model selection from the winning config layer.

name.description: Model id or alias, as written.

file.description: Settings layer that supplied the value.

ObservedSession.description: The session the observed states come from.

at.description: Time of the listing, as recorded.

model.description: Model id that answered in that session.

ListingThresholds.description: The listing costs, in the listing's `budget_unit`.

tier.description: The tier the budget puts the listing in.

names_only_cost.description: Cost with names and paths only.

roots_table_cost.description:
Cost of the skill roots table that short paths need; included in
both costs above.

average_line_cost.description: Average cost of one more name-and-path line.

average_description_chars.description: Average description characters each listed skill keeps.

cap.description: The highest budget the setting accepts.

summary.description: The tier and the distance to the next one, in plain words.

ListingTier.description: Which of Codex's three listing forms applies.

oneOf.description: Every skill is listed; descriptions are cut to about the same length.
No descriptions; skills past the budget are left out.

ListingEntry.description: One skill in one harness listing.

name.description: Name as the harness lists it. Claude Code prefixes plugin skills.

path.description: Deployment folder. Null for entries known only from a session.

plugin.description: Plugin identified by the scanner. Other entries come from a skill folder or session.

state.description: Model listing state for a preview. For discovery, describes the scanned entry only.

hidden_reason.description: Why a hidden skill is hidden.

description_preview.description: Exact text for scanned Claude Code and Codex skills with a description.

shown_description_chars.description: Description characters in the preview, or in the discovered metadata for discovery rows.

usage_score.description: Claude Code's usage score: uses times a 7-day half-life decay, at least 10%.

observed.description: State in the last recorded session, when one was found.

scanned.description: False for entries Skill Studio does not scan, such as bundled skills.

observed_description_chars.description:
Description characters in the last recorded session, when one was
found and the harness records them (Codex).

invocation_mismatch.description:
Set when another agent's invocation setting disagrees with this one,
such as a skill Claude Code keeps manual-only that Codex still lists.
Holds the skill name.

ListingState.description: What one harness shows the model for one skill.

oneOf.description: Not listed: the budget ran out.
Not listed: manual-only, off, parked, or rejected.

ListingDescription.description: Wording from the local skill after the harness applies its listing limits.

shown.description: The description in the estimated listing.
